questions.skill: Represent the sample space of a compound event with a list, a table, or a tree diagram
questions.prompt: A coin is flipped and a spinner with sections 1, 2, and 3 is spun. List the sample space.
questions.prompt_markup:
A coin is flipped and a spinner with sections 1, 2, and 3 is spun.
List the sample space.

questions.skill: Represent the sample space of a compound event with a list, a table, or a tree diagram
questions.prompt: A café offers 3 sandwiches (ham, egg, tuna) and 2 drinks (milk, juice). Make an organized list of every sandwich-and-drink pair.
questions.prompt_markup:
A café offers 3 sandwiches (ham, egg, tuna) and 2 drinks (milk, juice).
Make an organized list of every sandwich-and-drink pair.
questions.correct_answer: ham-milk, ham-juice, egg-milk, egg-juice, tuna-milk, tuna-juice
questions.grading_note: All 6 pairs are required, in any order or format.

questions.skill: Represent the sample space of a compound event with a list, a table, or a tree diagram
questions.prompt: Draw a tree diagram for choosing a shirt (red or blue) and then pants (black, tan, or gray). Write the outcome at the end of each branch.
questions.prompt_markup: Draw a tree diagram for choosing a shirt (red or blue) and then pants (black, tan, or gray). Write the outcome at the end of each branch.
questions.correct_answer: A tree with 2 first branches (red, blue), each splitting into 3 branches (black, tan, gray), ending in 6 outcomes: red-black, red-tan, red-gray, blue-black, blue-tan, blue-gray.

questions.skill: Represent the sample space of a compound event with a list, a table, or a tree diagram
questions.prompt: Complete the table to show the sample space for flipping a coin and then rolling a number cube numbered 1 to 6.
questions.prompt_markup: Complete the table to show the sample space for flipping a coin and then rolling a number cube numbered 1 to 6.
questions.correct_answer: Row H: H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6. Row T: T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6 (12 outcomes).

questions.skill: Represent the sample space of a compound event with a list, a table, or a tree diagram
questions.prompt: A first coin and a second coin are flipped. Make an organized list of the sample space. Then list the outcomes in the event "exactly one head."
questions.prompt_markup:
A first coin and a second coin are flipped.
Make an organized list of the sample space. Then list the outcomes in the event "exactly one head."
questions.correct_answer: HH, HT, TH, TT; the event "exactly one head" is HT and TH.
questions.grading_note: Grade both: all 4 outcomes (HT and TH listed separately), and the event HT, TH.

sections.skill: Organize two categorical variables in a two-way table

questions.skill: Organize two categorical variables in a two-way table
questions.prompt: In a class, 14 students have a sibling and 10 do not. 8 of the students with a sibling have a pet. 3 of the students without a sibling have a pet. Complete the two-way table.
questions.prompt_markup:
In a class, 14 students have a sibling and 10 do not. 8 of the students with a sibling have a pet. 3 of the students without a sibling have a pet.
Complete the two-way table.
questions.correct_answer: Sibling: 8 pet, 6 no pet, 14 total. No sibling: 3 pet, 7 no pet, 10 total. Totals: 11 pet, 13 no pet, 24 in all.

figure.description: Table.  | Pet | No pet | Total / Sibling |            |            |            / No sibling |            |            |            / Total |            |            |           .

questions.skill: Organize two categorical variables in a two-way table
questions.prompt: A class has 30 students. 18 like soccer. 12 of the soccer fans also like basketball. 4 of the students who do not like soccer like basketball. Complete the two-way table.
questions.prompt_markup:
A class has 30 students. 18 like soccer. 12 of the soccer fans also like basketball. 4 of the students who do not like soccer like basketball.
Complete the two-way table.
questions.correct_answer: Soccer: 12 basketball, 6 no basketball, 18 total. No soccer: 4 basketball, 8 no basketball, 12 total. Totals: 16 basketball, 14 no basketball, 30 in all.

figure.description: Table.  | Basketball | No basketball | Total / Soccer |            |            |            / No soccer |            |            |            / Total |            |            |           .

questions.skill: Organize two categorical variables in a two-way table

questions.prompt_markup:
50 shoppers were counted. 20 used a coupon. 15 of the coupon users paid by card. 25 of the shoppers paid by card.
Complete the two-way table.
questions.correct_answer: Coupon: 15 card, 5 cash, 20 total. No coupon: 10 card, 20 cash, 30 total. Totals: 25 card, 25 cash, 50 in all.

figure.description: Table.  | Card | Cash | Total / Coupon |            |            |            / No coupon |            |            |            / Total |            |            |           .

questions.skill: Organize two categorical variables in a two-way table

questions.skill: Organize two categorical variables in a two-way table
questions.prompt: 90 students were surveyed. 40 walk to school, and 25 of them eat breakfast at home. 30 of the students who do not walk eat breakfast at home. Complete the two-way table.
questions.prompt_markup:
90 students were surveyed. 40 walk to school, and 25 of them eat breakfast at home. 30 of the students who do not walk eat breakfast at home.
Complete the two-way table.
